versos.grego: Τὰ τέκνα, ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν ὑμῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ· τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν δίκαιον.

controles.web: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
controles.kjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
controles.livre: Filhos, sede obedientes aos vossos pais no Senhor, porque isso é justo.

versos.grego: τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τὴν μητέρα, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη ἐν ἐπαγγελίᾳ,

controles.web: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
controles.kjv: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
controles.livre: Honra teu pai, e tua mãe (que é o primeiro mandamento com promessa);

versos.grego: ἵνα εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ἔσῃ μακροχρόνιος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
controles.kjv: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
controles.livre: para que te vá bem, e vivas muito tempo sobre a terra.

versos.grego: Καὶ οἱ πατέρες, μὴ παροργίζετε τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφετε αὐτὰ ἐν παιδείᾳ καὶ νουθεσίᾳ Κυρίου.

controles.web: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
controles.kjv: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
controles.livre: Pais, não provoqueis à ira os vossos filhos, mas criai-os na disciplina e correção do Senhor.

versos.grego: Οἱ δοῦλοι, ὑπακούετε τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου ἐν ἁπλότητι τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς τῷ Χριστῷ,

controles.web: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;
controles.kjv: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
controles.livre: Servos, obedecei aos vossos senhores segundo a carne, com temor e tremor, em sinceridade do vosso coração, assim como a Cristo;

versos.grego: μὴ κατ’ ὀφθαλμοδουλίαν ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι, ἀλλ’ ὡς δοῦλοι Χριστοῦ ποιοῦντες τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐκ ψυχῆς,

controles.web: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
controles.kjv: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
controles.livre: não servindo somente quando vistos, como para agradar pessoas; mas sim, como servos de Cristo, fazendo de coração a vontade de Deus;

versos.grego: μετ’ εὐνοίας δουλεύοντες, ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις,

controles.web: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men;
controles.kjv: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
controles.livre: servindo de boa vontade como ao Senhor, e não aos pessoas.

versos.grego: εἰδότες ὅτι ἕκαστος ἐάν τι ποιήσῃ ἀγαθόν, τοῦτο κομίσεται παρὰ Κυρίου, εἴτε δοῦλος εἴτε ἐλεύθερος.

controles.web: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
controles.kjv: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
controles.livre: Pois sabeis que cada um receberá do Senhor todo o bem que fizer, seja servo, seja livre.

versos.grego: Καὶ οἱ κύριοι, τὰ αὐτὰ ποιεῖτε πρὸς αὐτούς, ἀνιέντες τὴν ἀπειλήν, εἰδότες ὅτι καὶ αὐτῶν καὶ ὑμῶν ὁ Κύριός ἐστιν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ προσωπολημψία οὐκ ἔστιν παρ’ αὐτῷ.

controles.web: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
controles.kjv: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
controles.livre: Senhores, fazei o mesmo a eles, abandonando as ameaças, pois sabeis também que o Senhor vosso e deles está nos céus, e que com ele não há acepção de pessoas.

versos.grego: Τοῦ λοιποῦ, ἐνδυναμοῦσθε ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ κράτει τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
controles.kjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
controles.livre: Por fim, fortalecei-vos no Senhor e na força do seu poder.

versos.grego: ἐνδύσασθε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ πρὸς τὸ δύνασθαι ὑμᾶς στῆναι πρὸς τὰς μεθοδίας τοῦ διαβόλου·

controles.web: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
controles.kjv: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
controles.livre: Revesti-vos de toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais estar firmes contra as ciladas do diabo.

versos.grego: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἡ πάλη πρὸς αἷμα καὶ σάρκα, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὰς ἀρχάς, πρὸς τὰς ἐξουσίας, πρὸς τοὺς κοσμοκράτορας τοῦ σκότους τούτου, πρὸς τὰ πνευματικὰ τῆς πονηρίας ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις.

controles.web: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
controles.kjv: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
controles.livre: Pois temos de lutar não contra carne e sangue, mas sim contra os domínios e poderes, contra os senhores destas trevas, contra os males espirituais nos lugares celestes.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο ἀναλάβετε τὴν πανοπλίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἵνα δυνηθῆτε ἀντιστῆναι ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ πονηρᾷ καὶ ἅπαντα κατεργασάμενοι στῆναι.

controles.web: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.
controles.kjv: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
controles.livre: Portanto pegai toda a armadura de Deus, para que possais resistir no dia mal, e depois que fizerdes tudo, continuar firmes.

versos.grego: στῆτε οὖν περιζωσάμενοι τὴν ὀσφὺν ὑμῶν ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν θώρακα τῆς δικαιοσύνης,

controles.web: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
controles.kjv: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
controles.livre: Estai, pois, firmes, com a vossa cintura envolvida com o cinturão da verdade, e vestidos com a couraça da justiça;

versos.grego: καὶ ὑποδησάμενοι τοὺς πόδας ἐν ἑτοιμασίᾳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς εἰρήνης,

controles.web: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;
controles.kjv: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
controles.livre: e calçados os pés com a prontidão do evangelho da paz.

versos.grego: ἐν πᾶσιν ἀναλαβόντες τὸν θυρεὸν τῆς πίστεως, ἐν ᾧ δυνήσεσθε πάντα τὰ βέλη τοῦ πονηροῦ τὰ πεπυρωμένα σβέσαι·

controles.web: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
controles.kjv: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
controles.livre: Em tudo pegai o escudo da fé, com o qual podereis apagar todas as flechas inflamadas do maligno.

versos.grego: καὶ τὴν περικεφαλαίαν τοῦ σωτηρίου δέξασθε, καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν τοῦ Πνεύματος, ὅ ἐστιν ῥῆμα Θεοῦ,

controles.web: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
controles.kjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
controles.livre: Pegai também o capacete da salvação, e a espada do Espírito, que é a palavra de Deus;

versos.grego: διὰ πάσης προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως, προσευχόμενοι ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ ἐν Πνεύματι, καὶ εἰς αὐτὸ ἀγρυπνοῦντες ἐν πάσῃ προσκαρτερήσει καὶ δεήσει περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων,

controles.web: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:
controles.kjv: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
controles.livre: orando em todo tempo com toda oração e súplica no Espírito, e vigiando nisso com toda perseverança e súplica por todos os santos,

versos.grego: καὶ ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ, ἵνα μοι δοθῇ λόγος ἐν ἀνοίξει τοῦ στόματός μου, ἐν παρρησίᾳ γνωρίσαι τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

controles.web: on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
controles.kjv: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
controles.livre: e por mim; a fim de que, quando eu abrir a boca, me seja dada palavra com ousadia, para tornar conhecido o mistério do evangelho,

versos.grego: ὑπὲρ οὗ πρεσβεύω ἐν ἁλύσει, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ παρρησιάσωμαι ὡς δεῖ με λαλῆσαι.

controles.web: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
controles.kjv: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
controles.livre: pelo qual sou embaixador acorrentado;  para que dele eu possa falar com ousadia, como devo falar.

versos.grego: Ἵνα δὲ εἰδῆτε καὶ ὑμεῖς τὰ κατ’ ἐμέ, τί πράσσω, πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἀδελφὸς καὶ πιστὸς διάκονος ἐν Κυρίῳ,

controles.web: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things;
controles.kjv: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
controles.livre: Para que também vós possais saber o que acontece comigo, e o que eu faço, Tíquico, o irmão amado, e fiel servidor do Senhor vos informará de tudo.

versos.grego: ὃν ἔπεμψα πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο, ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν καὶ παρακαλέσῃ τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν.

controles.web: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.
controles.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
controles.livre: Eu o enviei até vós para isso, para que saibais o que acontece conosco, e ele conforte os vossos corações.

versos.grego: Εἰρήνη τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς καὶ ἀγάπη μετὰ πίστεως ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Paz seja com os irmãos, e amor com fé, da parte de Deus Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων τὸν Κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐν ἀφθαρσίᾳ.

controles.web: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
controles.kjv: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.  Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
controles.livre: A graça seja com todos os que amam ao nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo com amor que não falha.
